verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic automation is a fair question for a payroll and HR SaaS, which could expose an API or CLI, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents UI-driven workflows (side navigation, Time Off tab, Connect Xero), and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. The Xero invoice auto-sync is an adjacent integration feature, not headless or CI operation of the product.
